description: SOC Dashboard (12) input. There is no backend dashboard route and no dashboard table: the page composes existing read APIs client-side. This file therefore declares which REAL datasets must be ingested to make the dashboard meaningful, instead of duplicating event files or hardcoding rows. Ingest 00_full_soc_scenario/attack_chain.jsonl once; the dashboard then derives its state from the persisted detections, correlations, risk assessments, TI indicators, hunts, approvals and SOAR executions this run created.
note: Levels, counts and time series are computed in the frontend from these read models. The pack never writes a dashboard row.
